conventions.commits: Conventional Commits with GPG signing and DCO Signed-off-by (CONTRIBUTING.md lines 25, 62-70, 80, 148); recent history uses feat(core): ... (#NNNN) form, e.g. dbc2971 feat(core): add Swift language support with tree-sitter-swift handler (#1742). Note: the issue states external PRs are not accepted; this is a maintainer-only task.
conventions.testing: Inline #[cfg(test)] mod tests in each languages/<lang>.rs (queries_compile, element happy path, extract_inheritance cases, defuse write site); table-driven test in languages/mod.rs; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder/tests/ using common::call_tool_raw and NamedTempFile::with_suffix_in(cwd). Test-code exemptions for unwrap_used/expect_used via cfg_attr in lib.rs.
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check; cargo clippy --locked --profile ci -- -D warnings -W clippy::cognitive_complexity (ci.yml line 137); workspace lints deny undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used; cargo deny check advisories licenses bans (ci.yml line 211); REUSE compliance; SPDX header on every file.
conventions.error_handling: Handlers return Option/Vec with no errors (extract_inheritance returns Vec<String>, handlers return Option<String>); registry failures surface as ParserError::UnsupportedLanguage or ParserError::QueryError via build_compiled_queries; node text via get_node_text (bounds-checked) or bounds-checked slices.

patterns: Each language module exports ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY as &'static str raw strings (java.rs lines 3-35).

Element capture contract: 'function' with 'func_name' or 'method_name', and 'class' with 'class_name' or 'type_name' (parser_elements.rs 271-300); interfaces, traits and enums reuse the 'class' capture (java.rs lines 12-21).
Call capture contract: only captures named 'call' are consumed (parser_elements.rs 495-497).
DEFUSE_QUERY captures carry a prefix write., read. or writeread.; extract_def_use keeps a capture only when node text equals the symbol name exactly (parser_elements.rs 858-880).
Inheritance handler signature fn(&Node, &str) -> Vec<String>; output prefixes are 'extends X' / 'implements X' (java.rs 131-165).
Swift walks named children of inheritance_specifier without field names (swift.rs 49-79); PHP needs the same approach because base_clause has no field name in the grammar.
Registry: one match arm per language in get_language_info (full LanguageInfo literal) and a separate arm in get_ts_language (mod.rs 71-335).
Lazy per-language query compilation via QUERY_CACHE / OnceLock (parser.rs 90-130), so a new language adds no startup cost.
Languages without an inheritance concept set extract_inheritance: None; without defuse set defuse_query: None (fortran, css, yaml, markdown).

constraints: tree-sitter workspace version is 0.27.1 (Cargo.toml) and 0.27.2 is locked; tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 depends on tree-sitter-language 0.1 at runtime and tree-sitter 0.27 only as dev-dependency, so no second tree-sitter runtime is pulled in.

Crate age gate: tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 has GitHub release date 2026-11-19 (about 8 days before this run); crates.io publish date was not verified. 0.25.1 (2026-10-06) is the safe fallback if the 0.25.2 entry is younger than 7 days at merge time.
Use LANGUAGE_PHP (not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY): the issue requires mixed HTML plus <?php ... ?> files to parse with zero ERROR nodes; LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY cannot handle text outside PHP tags.
Workspace lint deny rules (unwrap_used, expect_used, undocumented_unsafe_blocks); tree-sitter-php exposes its LanguageFn via an unsafe from_raw inside the crate, which is not our unsafe block.
Capture names are a contract with parser_elements.rs; new capture names outside the documented set are silently ignored.

DEFUSE_QUERY is typed Option<&'static str> (mod.rs line 63), so the compiler does not require it. Its requirement is convention and the issue's five-query scope; its only production consumer (extract_def_use_for_file) is test-only since the symbol tool was removed (parser.rs 549-551 comment), so it is required for test parity, not for runtime behaviour.
supported_languages() in lang.rs is stale (lists no css or yaml) and is used to size QUERY_CACHE; adding php is still required and the stale entries are a separate cleanup.

The issue scope restricts README edits; ARCHITECTURE.md, crates/aptu-coder/src/lib.rs line 23, crates/aptu-coder-core/src/lib.rs line 11, crates/aptu-coder-core/README.md lines 22 and 66 and languages/mod.rs line 8 also list languages and would drift. AGENTS.md forbids files outside issue scope, so flag rather than edit.
Issue acceptance: no SKIP_PACKAGE_AGE_CHECK; GPG-signed and DCO-signed commits; REUSE; binary size delta in PR description.
test_coverage: languages/java.rs, swift.rs, css.rs, kotlin.rs and others carry inline unit tests (queries compile, element happy path, inheritance cases, defuse write site). languages/mod.rs has test_get_language_info_known/unknown/covers_remaining_registered_languages (table with tsx, fortran, markdown, css, yaml) and does not yet include swift or php. lang.rs has extension happy-path and edge-case tests and a schemars pattern test that iterates supported_extensions(), so a php entry is covered automatically. parser.rs has a lazy-compile test bounded by supported_languages().len(). aptu-coder/tests has no per-language analyze_file test for swift or kotlin; core tests/integration_tests.rs has per-language analyze_file tests for tsx, c and cpp (lines 3141-3280), which is the closest pattern for the PHP integration test.

approaches.name: A: Full parity with the issue (recommended)
approaches.description: Add tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 to workspace and core Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock; create languages/php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY (function_definition, method_declaration, class/interface/trait/enum), CALL_QUERY (function, member, nullsafe member, scoped calls), REFERENCE_QUERY (named_type), IMPORT_QUERY (namespace_use_declaration), DEFUSE_QUERY (assignment, augmented assignment, update, parameter, variable reads), and extract_inheritance walking base_clause and class_interface_clause children; wire 'php' in mod.rs (pub mod, get_language_info with LANGUAGE_PHP, get_ts_language), lang.rs (EXTENSION_MAP, supported_languages); add inline unit tests, a mod.rs table row, an integration test under crates/aptu-coder/tests/, and the README line.
pros: Meets every acceptance criterion in the issue
Same shape as java.rs and swift.rs, so review is mechanical
DEFUSE_QUERY keeps parity with OO languages and its test pattern (test_defuse_query_write_site)
Uses LANGUAGE_PHP so HTML-mixed files parse cleanly
cons: Largest diff; DEFUSE_QUERY has no runtime consumer today
Node-kind mistakes only surface at query-compile time, so a queries_compile test is mandatory
Requires the crate age check to be satisfied (0.25.2 is about 8 days old)

approaches.name: B: Minimal runtime slice (defuse None, Fortran-style)
approaches.description: Same as A but set defuse_query: None and omit DEFUSE_QUERY; keep ELEMENT, CALL, IMPORT and inheritance; REFERENCE_QUERY may be None as in css.rs.
pros: Smallest code surface; fewer query nodes to get wrong
Matches fortran and css precedent for None defuse
Still satisfies the user-visible analyze_file / analyze_module acceptance items
cons: Breaks the issue's explicit five-query scope and the 'five query constants' acceptance wording
Drops defuse test parity with every other OO language
Reviewer will ask for the missing constant

approaches.name: C: Pure-PHP grammar (LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY) with extension-based routing
approaches.description: Use LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY for .php files and keep the full-grammar only for mixed files, or register a second key such as 'php_only'.
pros: Simpler grammar for plain PHP files
Smaller node-type surface in some cases
cons: Fails the issue's HTML-template acceptance item (text outside <?php ?> is not parsed)
Needs two registry keys or a routing branch, which the registry does not support
Not what the issue asks for

recommendation: Approach A. It is the only option that meets every acceptance item, including the HTML-mixed file (which requires LANGUAGE_PHP, not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY) and the five-query scope. Keep DEFUSE_QUERY even though it is Option-typed and test-only at runtime: it is required by the issue's scope and by the test pattern every OO handler follows. Pin tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 only if it is at least 7 days old at merge time; otherwise use 0.25.1. Do not add trait use resolution, property or constant extraction, or the three unused handlers, per the issue's Not in Scope. Flag the other language lists (ARCHITECTURE.md, lib.rs docs, core README) to the maintainer rather than editing them.

Node kinds and fields, each confirmed in php/src/node-types.json: function_definition (field name: name, grammar common/define-grammar.js line 523); method_declaration (field name: name, line 454); class_declaration (field name: name, line 365); interface_declaration (field name: name, line 326); trait_declaration (field name: name, line 319); enum_declaration (field name: name, line 339). Captures use the names parser_elements.rs already consumes: func_name/method_name for the name, function/class for the outer node.
defuse_query_draft:
(assignment_expression
  left: (variable_name (name) @write.assign))
(augmented_assignment_expression
  left: (variable_name (name) @writeread.assign))
(update_expression
  argument: (variable_name (name) @writeread.update))
(simple_parameter
  name: (variable_name (name) @write.param))
(variable_name (name) @read.usage)

Adapted from java.rs DEFUSE_QUERY (write.local on variable_declarator, write.assign on assignment_expression left, writeread.update on update_expression, read.usage on every identifier). PHP has no local declaration statement, so the first write site is an assignment_expression whose left field is variable_name (node-types: assignment_expression.left types include variable_name). Capturing the inner name node keeps captured text equal to the bare symbol (e.g. total), matching parser_elements.rs 858-880, which compares node text to symbol_name exactly. Dedup by start_byte works because write and read captures both target the same name node. Required because DEFUSE_QUERY is what makes extract_def_use_for_file return sites; the java-style test test_defuse_query_write_site needs a Write site.
inheritance_walk_citation: Grammar source inspected: php/grammar.js (1 line, defineGrammar('php')) and common/define-grammar.js lines 260-400; node-types.json class_declaration entry. Walk for a class_declaration node N: (1) name = N.child_by_field_name("name") (field 'name' of type name; define-grammar.js line 365-374: seq(attributes?, repeat(_modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', reserved('classes', name)), optional(base_clause), optional(class_interface_clause), field('body', declaration_list))). (2) extends clause: iterate N's children (no field name) and select kind == "base_clause"; base_clause is seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1(_name)) (define-grammar.js lines 334-337), with named children of kinds name, qualified_name or relative_name (node-types base_clause children: required, multiple, types [name, qualified_name, relative_name]). Each named child yields "extends <text>". (3) implements clause: iterate N's children and select kind == "class_interface_clause"; define-grammar.js lines 381-384: seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1(_name)); named children are the same three kinds and yield "implements <text>". Interfaces use interface_declaration whose optional base_clause carries multiple parent interfaces (lines 326-332). No clauses means no base_clause or class_interface_clause children, so the result is an empty Vec. Note: unlike java.rs, the grammar gives these clauses no field names, so child iteration by kind (as swift.rs does) is required.
